cohort: Pregnant women admitted to the feto-maternal medicine wing of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University, Bangladesh, over a 2-year period
finding: Hepatitis E was the most common cause of jaundice in pregnancy (80.4% of cases), and jaundice in pregnancy was associated with significant maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality.
birth_weight: Measured, results reported as percentage low birth weight
